data_fields.name: total_budget
data_fields.donor_constant: m_cNumMonsters from monstercount; disables at exactly 0

data_fields.name: fade_budget_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (fade flag off when budget is 1; only controls owner-link clearing at death)

best_idea: A spawner that re-arms its timer before every attempt, so a refused attempt (at the live cap, or with a player or monster in the spot) waits a full interval, and counts its live children down through a death notice.
decision_why: The fixed-interval attempt, the live cap and the death-notice decrement map onto row 23 population directly; the ground trace, the owner pointer and the Valve licence mean only the shape is taken, with the spot check written as a server-side occupancy test in our own spawn code.
acceptance: Server test: 10-second interval, live cap 3 and budget 6 never allow more than 3 live children, an attempt into a spot holding a player is skipped and retried only after the next interval, and the maker stops after 6 spawns.
